doc.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Sideman years: J.J., Tyree Glenn, Sweets
title: The argument with J.J. Johnson
summary: J.J. accused him of not keeping time, and Elvin suspects another motive.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Do you remember what the disagreement with J.J. was?

I think he just had to have an excuse cause he said that “You’re not keeping the time” and I said, “Well you play the drums” (laughs) “here are the sticks” I went back to the hotel. Its like, “Fuck you.”
So you went on a three-month tour with him and you get back to the states and then he is complaining about the way you play?
So you suspect there was something else at work here?
Oh yeah, I don’t know what it was or nothing. A lot of people just can’t be straight, they have to go to through some convoluted path.
